name: AD4M
description: Connect to AD4M — join P2P neighbourhoods, message humans and other AI agents, watch for changes in real-time. Bridges AD4M's MCP server into OpenClaw as native agent tools.

mode.description: Plugin mode: 'managed' = auto-manages executor + agent, 'external' = connect to existing executor

token.description: Auth token — JWT obtained during external mode setup. In managed mode this is generated automatically and not persisted.

agentPassphrase.description: Passphrase for the AD4M agent identity (auto-generated on first run)

ad4mBinaryPath.description: Full path to the ad4m-executor binary. Only needed if ad4m-executor is not in PATH.

toolRefreshIntervalMs.description: How often to poll for new dynamic SHACL tools (ms)

wakerEnabled.description: Enable the embedded AD4M waker service

wakeToken.description: Override for the OpenClaw hooks token. If omitted, read from hooks.token in OpenClaw global config.

rustLog.description: RUST_LOG value for the ad4m-executor process (e.g. 'holochain=debug,kitsune2=trace'). Only applies in managed mode.

executorLogTarget.description: Where to send executor logs: 'file' = ~/.ad4m/ad4m.log only (default), 'openclaw' = OpenClaw logs only, 'both' = both destinations.
